About the artist

A mind that is never quiet, and hands that cannot keep still.

She is drawn to philosophy, and to the question beneath every gesture: why people feel, and act, as they do. Observant by nature, her mind is always occupied, turning things over and finding the absurd tucked inside the most ordinary emotions.

What the mind gathers, the hands release. There is a fire in her fingers, and it carries feeling from the depths of the heart onto the page, through ink, graphite, watercolor and gold script.

Pieces are shared as they are made on @pixel_n_paint_, and this journal collects them in one place.
